shell_commands:
grep -n "it(" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | while read line; do 
  line_num=$(echo $line | cut -d: -f1)
  next_it=$(grep -n "it(" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | grep -A 1 "^$line_num:" | tail -n 1 | cut -d: -f1)
  if [ "$line_num" == "$next_it" ]; then
    next_it=$(wc -l < src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts)
  fi
  expects=$(sed -n "${line_num},${next_it}p" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | grep "expect(" | wc -l)
  if [ $expects -gt 1 ]; then
    echo "Line $line_num: $expects expects"
    sed -n "${line_num},${next_it}p" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | grep -n "it("
  fi
done
git add . && git commit -m "Fix CI failures: fix PromptBuilder type, combine expect calls, and update spec links"
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD
